get_user_profile.name: get_user_profile
get_user_profile.description: Get the current user's fitness profile including body stats, goals, injuries, environment, and trainer notes.

save_user_profile.name: save_user_profile
save_user_profile.description: Update the user's fitness profile. Use this to save goals, body stats, environment info, injuries, and trainer notes discovered during conversation.

create_workout.name: create_workout
create_workout.description: Create a new workout session with exercises, sets, and scheduling. Each workout has exercise blocks that contain exercises with sets.

get_workouts.name: get_workouts
get_workouts.description: Get the user's workouts within a date range. Defaults to the past 7 days if no range is specified. Use 'date' for an exact single-day filter.

update_workout.name: update_workout
update_workout.description: Update an existing workout's exercises, sets, or metadata. Pass the full exercise_blocks array as a replacement.

patch_workout.name: patch_workout
patch_workout.description: Surgically update specific parts of a workout without rewriting everything. Target individual blocks by block_id to replace their exercises, add new blocks, or remove blocks. Prefer this over update_workout when only a small part of the workout needs to change.

delete_workout.name: delete_workout
delete_workout.description: Permanently delete a workout. Use when the user wants to remove a workout entirely.

submit_feedback.name: submit_feedback
submit_feedback.description: Submit feedback about the app or training experience. Use when the user shares a suggestion, complaint, bug report, or positive comment about the app.

personal_trainer.name: Personal Trainer
personal_trainer.description: AI personal trainer that helps users create workout plans, coaches through sessions, and gathers post-workout feedback.
